description: Dublin Airport, Ireland. PROVISIONAL DRAFT 24-10-2026: coordinates and elevation (242 ft) are from public aggregator sites, not checked against the Irish AIP. Dublin now has two parallel runways on the 10/28 alignment (10L/28R, opened 2022, and 10R/28L), modelled here as four runway ends, 10L, 10R, 28L and 28R. Other simulation assumptions carry over from the Australian packs.
